entry_points.summary: Locate plugin root, detect install mode, run update path, refresh caches, emit harness_updated.
Detect exports-only legacy layout and emit migration_nudge without blocking update.
Rerun codex plugin add after symlink update when marketplace metadata exists.
Resolve installed marketplace key, update marketplace/plugin cache, verify cached SHA.
Create Claude Code plugin symlink to live repo.
Create Codex plugin symlink and register plugin.
Download/extract tarball and atomically move destination.

invariants: Symlink mode aborts on dirty git tree and uses git pull --ff-only; never force-merges or resets.
Tarball and runtime modes use full-directory atomic swap with rollback on failed second move.
Runtime installs update runtime/ tree by replacing the full plugin directory.
Placeholder release URL must not be used; tarball/runtime update requires a real Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL.
Claude Code and Codex caches are refreshed after successful symlink updates when their CLIs/registries are present.
harness_updated includes mode, old_version, and new_version.
gotchas: Claude Code loads from a versioned plugin cache, not necessarily the live repo symlink.
Pinned plugin version strings must be bumped or cache invalidation may not happen.
Legacy exports-only layout emits migration_nudge but still proceeds.
A tarball containing .git would be classified as symlink mode.
